blocks.text: South Korea proposed tracking the sale of disguised cameras in 2017 to curb illegal filming. A bill that would have required businesses and owners to register the devices later lapsed. Now, after the top scorer on a national tax accountant exam admitted to using a miniature camera and generative AI to cheat, the government is taking another look at how the devices are sold. “Like many other gender-related issues, miniature cameras seemed to receive less attention when the issue was raised in that context, both from society and the National Assembly,” said Kim Shin-hye, a woman in her 30s, in an […]...
